SAMPLE Wage Subsidy

The SAMPLE Wage Subsidy is a wage subsidy that helps employers hire new workers and pay their wages.

Employers with 50 employees or fewer can apply. Employers must be located in Newfoundland and Labrador.

The program pays up to 60% of wages, to a maximum of $15,000 per new hire.

Applications are open now and close October 15, 2026.
